$description: The ASYS tokens that are the same in every theme and palette: font families, type styles, spacing, radii, the type scale, sizes, durations and easings. Copied from the ASYS design system artifact, which stays the source of truth. Its tokens.json has no motion family, so the durations and easings mirror its README's States and motion section.

typography.$description: The type styles, in the design system groups Display, Text and Numbers. They are kept in $extensions, not as DTCG typography tokens, because those need a unitless line height and a px or rem letter spacing: ours are rem line heights that the Line spacing setting rewrites, and em letter spacings that follow the font size. Sizes and line heights refer to the type-scale tokens, which components read. The design system's components set weight and letter spacing in their own CSS, so those fields record the styles' values for a tool that emits type-style classes. DTCG tools leave the {…} references as plain text: whatever reads them must resolve them itself and fail on one that does not resolve.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The single top pick in Now (a quarter larger in Voice only) and the Task being triaged: one per screen. Sized so a three to five word Task title fits on one or two lines at 360px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles: Now, Today, Inbox, Weekly review.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen: Waiting, Not here, Overdue.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Task and Activity titles in lists.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Notes stay on the Task until you clear them.
styles.usage: Running text: Notes, dialogs, the README.

styles.name: reason
styles.usage: The one-line reason under a Task title, and metadata (Facts, dates, counts in words). Always ink-muted. As large as body, so it reads at a glance; weight and colour keep it below the title.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, segment labels, bottom bar labels, the Voice word and button text at small size.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Clock times, Estimates and durations in Today and on rows, so columns line up. The same size as reason, so a row reads as one line.

styles.name: time-large
styles.usage: The length of the current Gap at the top of Now.
